description: This file defines constants and functions for managing plugin paths within the bundled plugin system, including generating directory paths and file paths for plugins and tests.

methods.name: bundledPluginRoot
methods.description: Generates the root directory path for a plugin based on plugin ID.

methods.name: bundledPluginFile
methods.description: Generates the full file path for a plugin's file given plugin ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginRoot
methods.description: Generates the distribution directory path for a plugin based on plugin ID.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginFile
methods.description: Generates the full distribution file path for a plugin's file.

methods.name: bundledPluginCallsite
methods.description: Constructs a string representing a plugin file path with a specific line number, useful for call site references.
